channel.title: My Blog
channel.description: Thoughts on building for the web

item.title: Notes on Simplicity
item.description: Simplicity isn't the absence of complexity. It's the result of understanding a problem well enough to solve it cleanly.

item.title: A Weekend with a Side Project
item.description: No stakeholders, no deadlines, no Jira tickets. Just you and a dumb idea that might turn into something.

item.title: Designing with Constraints
item.description: Limitations aren't obstacles to creativity. They're the structure that makes creativity possible.

item.title: Small Tools, Big Impact
item.description: The best developer tools do one thing well and get out of your way. A love letter to focused software.

item.title: Learning in Public
item.description: Writing about what you're learning is the fastest way to find out what you don't actually understand.

item.title: The Case for Static
item.description: Static sites aren't a step backwards. They're what you get when you take performance and simplicity seriously.

item.title: Building for the Long Term
item.description: The frameworks will change. The databases will change. What survives is the clarity of your thinking.
